dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the posterior margin forming a falcate profile from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderate pixel radius with a rounded classification at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc defining the melon's anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stout beak extending from the melon with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic luminescence across the entire morphological surface.
